# iA Writer Duo and Mono (static TTFs)

Copied unmodified from <https://github.com/iaolo/iA-Fonts> at commit
`f32c04c3058a75d7ce28919ce70fe8800817491b` (`iA Writer Duo/Static` and
`iA Writer Mono/Static`). Font family names: **iA Writer Duo S** and **iA Writer Mono S**.

Copyright © 2018 Information Architects Inc. with Reserved Font Name "iA Writer";
based on IBM Plex, Copyright © 2017 IBM Corp. with Reserved Font Name "Plex".
Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 — see `Duo/LICENSE.md` and
`Mono/LICENSE.md` (identical).

zwriter embeds these files in its binary (`src/fonts.qrc`) and registers them at start-up
(`main.cpp`); they are not installed system-wide. The fonts are not modified, so the
Reserved Font Names are used as published.
